# Night Nine soundtrack

**Music by Sepehr (S3pehR) Pakbaz. Music generated by Google Lyria 3.5.** In all 30 original MP3s, the embedded ID3 artist is **s3pehR**. The total audio duration is 80 minutes and 35 seconds. Bellwether Bay (Tape Anomaly) joined the score on November 18, 2026; [where each recording plays](../../../docs/story-arc-rework.md#music-and-picture-sync). We preserved each original file, including its embedded title and cover art, in [the game’s music directory](../../../game/assets/audio/music/).

For the title menu and short chapter transitions, we measured the level of each suggested excerpt over 2.15 seconds and 4.4 seconds. On the title recording, the first 2.15 seconds measure −48.1 LUFS. Starting at 12.7 seconds gives an entrance of −20.3 LUFS. For full-track listening, start at the beginning. The epilogue theme runs 19.925 seconds.

We decoded every recording as 48 kHz stereo MP3 at 128 kb/s and checked each game file against the supplied original using SHA-256. We measured integrated loudness between −19.1 and −14.0 LUFS. The highest true peak was −0.1 dBTP. We found zero decoded channel samples at or above full scale. The cue sheet preserves the original filenames.

[Cue sheet](cue-sheet.csv) · [Track measurements, silence intervals and hashes](measurements.json) · [Game playback settings](../../../game/content/music.json)

## Completion reward

**Night Nine Loading Theme (Mysterious Take 2)** now scores the final credit film from the start, without looping. Its original MP3 is preserved as `game/assets/audio/music/credits-mysterious.mp3`. Its integrated loudness is -16.87 LUFS, measured with FFmpeg EBU R128; the score applies the existing credits-level trim.

The original **Epilogue (BGM)** now plays in the epilogue, so all 30 earlier recordings remain in the game alongside Take 2. The short **Epilogue** theme still plays once on the end card after the final radio signal. `tools/ending_reward.py` applies the same routing in both content generators.

## The bay's own music

Since November 26, 2026, **Prologue Background Music (Variation)** plays under the Prologue, *The Bay Is Singing*. Its original MP3 is preserved as `game/assets/audio/music/prologue-bgm-variation.mp3` (175.8 seconds, -15.1 LUFS integrated, -0.3 dBTP true peak). We measured its bar grid at 76 BPM, the same as the Three Nights theme, so the Prologue card still opens on a bar line. Veyr and Sentinel Point keep the Three Nights BGM.

## First loading screen

**Night Nine Loading Theme (Mysterious Take 1)** is preserved as `site/loading-screen-music.mp3`, outside the game pack so it can play during the download. Its integrated loudness is -16.88 LUFS. The browser uses a fixed 35% gain, with no dynamic volume riding, only on the first successful load per browser and site path. Playback ends when the loading overlay closes and never resumes over the intro narration. Browsers allow sound only after a click, so the landing page's **Play in browser** click starts the music with the download; opening the game page directly waits for the first click or key press.
